# The GEO Handbook

> Everything about Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) in one place: how to structure, write, and publish content so AI answer engines (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews, Gemini, Copilot) understand, trust, and cite it. Every claim carries a primary source. Maintained by ferinazumaDEV.

## Start here
- [Foundations — what GEO is and where to start](docs/01-foundations.md): definitions, first principles, the KDD 2024 paper.
- [Engines — how AI answer engines work](docs/02-engines.md): retrieval, ranking, and citation in generative search.

## Core chapters
- [Content](docs/03-content.md): writing and structuring for extraction and citation.
- [Technical](docs/04-technical.md): rendering, crawlability, structured data, llms.txt.
- [Authority](docs/05-authority.md): E-E-A-T, entities, and trust signals machines can read.
- [Measurement](docs/06-measurement.md): how to measure citation share and AI visibility.
- [Research & cases](docs/07-research-cases.md): the primary studies and what they found.
- [Future & ethics](docs/08-future-ethics.md): where GEO is going and the guardrails.
- [Glossary](docs/09-glossary.md): the vocabulary of GEO.

## Meta
- [README](README.md): what this is and how it's sourced.
- [Contributing](CONTRIBUTING.md): the cite-or-flag rule for every claim.
- [Changelog](CHANGELOG.md): versioned history.
